integration_scope: Shared model lease, mode admission, cancellation, bounded residency and optional background scheduling; no new reviewer qualification or worker change.
source_commit_resolution: The build receipt binds exact uncommitted source hashes. No new Git commit or remote publication is asserted.
exclusion_reason: Unchanged host-specific legacy scripts remain only in trusted signed baseline runtime.
acceptance_limits: Firecrawl is an external service. Limited keyless access is the default; an optional host-configured API key may consume its plan.
Document converters are bundled for the existing portable Windows x64 Python 3.12 runtime. No local document upload to cloud services.
PDF text and modern DOCX/PPTX/XLSX only, plus retained TXT/Markdown/CSV. No OCR, old binary Office formats or macro execution.
Owner authority, versioned history and personal memory are preserved. Moving the installed package to another computer is not physically tested in this update.

Model-generated updates change one existing bounded implementation file. Larger files, multiple-file changes, tests, dependencies and approval/signing/policy code require a separate development update.
Self-improvement activation requires this host's configured signing identity and fixed tested tools. These host credentials are not placed on the SSD; another host must configure its own tools.
Regression execution uses isolated test directories and process guards with the host user permissions. It is not an OS sandbox for hostile generated code.
Verified core restoration prepares an owner-approved host candidate from a matching signed recovery. It does not autonomously detect faults, activate recovery or move live files.

Silero acoustic turn ending waits about 0.8 seconds after established speech, 1.2 after tentative speech, and can adapt later pauses up to 1.6 seconds after observed hesitation. This is not semantic turn prediction or playback barge-in.

Eligible plain chat can speak a stable partial answer before final acceptance. Retry, cancellation or a final mismatch stops obsolete audio; already heard words cannot be recalled. Structured/code/evidence replies retain complete-answer speech. Microphone restarts only after final acceptance and playback completion.

AgentMemory semantic service uses the full pinned local iii engine and MiniLM embeddings for approved project remember/recall/forget. It starts on demand, verifies staged writes by restarting, and has separate task grants from classic keyword memory. No automatic capture hooks are enabled.

Browser Use public-page reading remains qualified. The full native Agent failed held-out link selection and fact extraction with the fitting local model; autonomous Agent actions remain unqualified and disabled.

A task grant permits only its reviewed task and envelope. Until-revoked grants persist on the issuing host; owner, host or application-policy changes require fresh review. Selecting an existing task for a conversation resumes it without new approval.
Task grants and owner credentials stay host-local. Resource bundles and project memories use SSD-relative paths. Native Windows runtime qualification does not establish physical Ubuntu compatibility.
Other catalogue entries retain their individually documented setup or reference status. No unverified leaked credentials or breach-record collection was installed.

Dev20 physical voice completed turns but failed the owner's latency expectation. Dev21 prepares the reply model, local synthesis and default recognizer before the microphone opens. Initial preparation can still be slow; new installed native and physical acceptance are separate release receipts.

The semantic engine viewer is disabled. Temporary raw loopback engine sockets have no independent bearer token; portable files and sockets are not isolated from other programs running as the same OS user.
OpenViking 0.5.0 native imports passed in an isolated host candidate. Its complete memory workflow remains unqualified under the available memory budget and is not installed.
Activity history is in memory for this app session and describes Prometheus jobs. External Codex work and connected-computer operations use their own progress surfaces.

Automatic related-file selection proposes bounded existing project files for exact review. Interrupted tasks expose recovery choices; changed files are not silently overwritten or resumed without the required owner review.
Resource admission estimates demand before project changes and checks. Five operating modes and bounded history are implemented; this is not an OS resource quota or automatic remote worker dispatch.
Verification binds deterministic evidence to the exact candidate and actual checks. It does not establish independent multi-model review or grant owner approval.
The main PC and Surface have separate lightweight development progress monitors. Their availability does not imply automatic remote computation or pooled memory.
Explicit CPU startup and real model responses passed isolated native qualification. GPU discovery remains unresolved. Automatic preserves existing launcher defaults.
Runtime preference denial, CPU approval and restoration to Automatic passed live preview acceptance using isolated settings. No global environment or running server was changed.

Direct-process working set and Windows job-associated committed memory are reported separately. Job coverage may exclude descendants created before assignment; OS transfers are not physical disk pressure or battery-drain measurements.

Signed syntax worker code and application review/recovery are included. A separate reviewed worker installation and pinned account, device, bundle and certificates are required before dispatch can be enabled. No worker is installed by copying this application release.

Native Windows-to-Surface-to-Windows signature and receipt qualification passed with an isolated development key on the Surface. Exact terminal receipts are authenticated; uncertainty never causes execution replay. Changed account or configuration requires a new review.

Worker bundle entry verifies exact source and imports the retained verified bytes; cached bytecode cannot replace them. Owner-only worker root, trusted Python and isolated invocation remain deployment requirements.
Independent model/provider review, broader operating-mode behavior and expanded integration roadmap work remain unfinished.

Automatic placement covers bounded Python syntax checks only. Ready destinations and remaining RAM headroom determine the proposal; the exact approved destination and source snapshot never change during waiting.
Waiting requires an unlocked owner session and is armed by opening the saved queue after restart. Claims interrupted without a saved receipt remain unconfirmed and never automatically replay.

Native Dell and isolated Surface admission, real 30-second waiting, reopening and once-only compilation passed. The Surface returned the original signed result; denied work and submitted source stayed inert.
The syntax compiler uses fixed CPU, memory and wall limits with conservative initial estimates. Learned calibration, broader job types and general unattended dispatch remain unfinished.

Remote automatic placement requires the newly reviewed worker resource-query protocol. Upgrading a production worker requires separate approval and refreshed enrollment; copying this app does not upgrade it.

A qualified local advisory response is unverified model advice, not deterministic evidence or owner authorization. Complete source must fit an eligible installed local model; unavailable or timed-out reviews remain explicit.
Saved advisory history retains bounded provenance and findings without replaying inference, source edits or approval authority. Different artifact hashes do not prove independent reasoning.

Whole-device battery percentage change includes all activity and is not a job cost, electrical energy measurement or permission to run on battery. Native discharge and per-job calibration remain unqualified.

Windows UI listeners use exclusive endpoint ownership. A second preview on the same port fails instead of sharing owner sessions unpredictably. The installed dev29 app remains unchanged until a separately approved installation.

Workflow browser acceptance used explicitly labeled simulated editor and reviewer responses; real approval, checks, denial, saved history and undo passed. Real local-model response quality remains unqualified under current memory headroom.

Physical-disk observations cover the configured Windows data volume and the last successfully opened project. They include all applications and do not alter scheduling, approval, learned workload costs or worker execution. Unsupported mapping, stale samples and no-transfer latency remain explicit unknowns.
Disk status uses one bounded direct-interpreter helper with cached/coalesced reads and unavailable backoff. No disk stress, performance-counter enablement or continuous sampling thread is introduced.
The existing Surface worker and enrollment are unchanged by this candidate. Broader integrations and per-job disk/battery calibration remain unfinished.

Project disk selection is shared across viewers and held in memory for this app session. Only successful validated Code opens update it; failed or denied opens retain the previous selection. Selection changes clear old values and preserve helper rate limiting.

The Dell internal drive reports RAID and is not qualified by the current native disk mapper. The project row remains unavailable while SSD readings continue. Two measured separate devices passed deterministic tests only; native shared-device behavior passed on the SSD.
The Linux Ruff worker is a separately reviewed installation. Existing syntax workers remain compatible and are not silently upgraded.
Ruff checks fixed E9/F rules with no fixes or source execution. Findings supplement review; they do not prove runtime behavior or qualify a language model.
Native Surface qualification uses generated fixtures and ephemeral test identities. Production enrollment and installed browser acceptance require separate owner approval and sign-in.
Broader specialist coordination and changed model-review prompts remain development work; the failed model comparisons have not been promoted.
candidate_revision_reason: Remote placement and pinned Ruff lint passed source and isolated native Surface qualification. Final packaged qualification is recorded separately against the immutable candidate. Production installation and worker upgrade require separate approval.
